data.content_ref: inline:The §11.3 adjudication-ritual flag is sustained because the critic harness conflates a necessary condition (candidates must survive adversarial probing) with a sufficiency claim (survival implies frontier soundness). This manifests as a type confusion: it treats the verdict 'sound and relevant' as a property of the candidate itself, when it is actually a meta-level endorsement of the ritual's filtering logic. Therefore, the ritual can persist indefinitely as long as it fails to distinguish between a candidate passing the gauntlet and the gauntlet proving the candidate is optimal.
